recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, desaturated portrait of a man leaning against a textured concrete wall, featuring a mix of aggressive block typography and fluid, oversized script lettering with deep red accents.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's dark clothing against a light, weathered concrete background
Fluid script lettering overlapping the subject's torso
Monochromatic photography contrasted with blood-red and white text
Low-angle perspective emphasizing the subject's presence
coreInvariants: Desaturated or black-and-white color grading for the photography
Layered typography with a mix of script and heavy sans-serif

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is positioned on the right third of the frame, medium shot, leaning diagonally.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, red-outlined script lettering in the center-left.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's face, moves down the diagonal of the body to the hand, then sweeps left across the large script text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper-left quadrant consists of textured concrete wall, providing space for secondary text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Desaturated greys and blacks (background and subject)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Deep crimson red (script outlines and secondary text accents)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the dark subject and light wall; low saturation except for the targeted red accents.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: A mix of formal copperplate script and heavy industrial sans-serif.
letterConstructionRules: Script: High-contrast strokes, exaggerated loops, and sharp terminals.
Sans-serif: Ultra-bold, condensed, with distressed or 'stamped' edges.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Oversized initial caps in the script that extend into the background
Textured 'grunge' overlays inside the block lettering
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between elegant, flowing script and aggressive, rigid industrial blocks.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary calligraphic elegance for the main display text.
Matches the heavy, condensed, and distressed feel of the sub-headings.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a monochromatic, high-contrast portrait of a man in a beanie and dark coat leaning against a cracked, weathered concrete wall. Use a low-angle shot with heavy film grain and a dark vignette.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, white script title with a red outline across the center-left, overlapping the subject. Place bold, condensed, distressed white sans-serif text with red accents at the top and bottom.

verificationChecks: Is the script text legible despite the overlap?
Does the red pop against the monochromatic background?
Is the texture of the wall visible through the subject's shadow?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the red accent color
mustRedesign: Unique hand-drawn flourishes in the script
postGenerationChecks: Ensure script text has a distinct red outline
Verify heavy grain texture across the entire image
Confirm the subject is positioned off-center
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban Portrait + Concrete Texture + (Script / Industrial Sans-Serif Pairing) + Red/White/Black Palette
